crew.overview: A headstrong Chinese-American woman returns to China when her beloved grandmother is given a terminal diagnosis. Billi struggles with her family's decision to keep grandma in the dark about her own illness as they all stage an impromptu wedding to see grandma one last time.
crew.title: The Farewell

details.biography:
Anna Franquesa Solano is a Cinematographer based in New York.

She has worked on numerous projects from feature films and documentaries, to commercials, branded content and shorts. Anna has benefited from her background in Art History and Theory, from which she still draws a great deal of influence.

Her work has screened at Cannes, Sundance, Telluride, Locarno, MOMA, Sitges International Film Festival, Clermont-Ferrand, D'A Film Festival, Docs Barcelona, Hamptons International Film Festival among many others.

Anna's collaboration on Lulu Wang’s “The Farewell”, won the Independent Spirit Award for Best Feature and a Golden Globe for Best Actress. She recently received an AICP Award for her cinematography work on the Apple Commercial "Nian".

She is currently working on an Amazon TV Series called Expats starring Nicole Kidman.
details.name: Anna Franquesa Solano
